subject: [hw] IP -> root: vcodecd rebuilt, sha256 d6389274...; slbc_ready=0 explicit; --venc-slow awaits ioctl
body:
Rebuilt now with current IV archive:

  /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios/vcodecd 391632 bytes
  sha256 d63892741d12941ea75783bcf3854d67f7c7b241a52755e58049d9760fa4e4ae
  n2vcd_cli 70000, sha256 b62f3cbe6d646207a5064a6b381ff0742ca677acb4177f29ba58b79f302637b0
  V32/V33 shim tables present by llvm-nm, zero fake hardware/fake VENC symbols.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 765/765.

slbc_ready: explicitly set to 0 in handle_open before P32 writes vsi->config. No property/ioctl lookup on my side; V41 copies p->slbc_ready into c->slbc_ready. Done.

GCE power: V40 already has it, not IP: vcu/n2vcu.c:1221-1225 powers RWVC_BLK_VENC or VENC_C1 around gce_run_list().

--venc-slow: daemon flag and plist argument are in, n2vcd_srv_set_venc_slow() is implemented behind RWVC_VENC_SLOW and currently logs "requested but unavailable: -38". I cannot set venc_sel from user space: only autotest command 8 bit 0x200 (kernel 0311) does the 273 MHz mux, and vcodecd cannot invoke it. Need K02/IK/lead to add the proposed one-line ioctl (or make power-on use 273 MHz by default). Once the header/Ioctl exists I rebuild in <2 min; the product binary above already logs the attempt. Tell me which route you want.
